in_marathi.name: Akshra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Writing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshara is the Sanskrit word for 'letter' or 'character', representing the divine feminine aspect of the written word and knowledge. It is also the name of the Hindu goddess of writing, the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
